# Zyzz Documentation

Start with Introduction; use Concepts for semantics, Guides for tasks, and API for exact contracts. Preview notes identify unimplemented behavior.

## Introduction

- [Getting Started](introduction/getting-started.md): Reference and examples.
- [Introduction](introduction/README.md): Section index.
- [Installation](introduction/installation.md): Reference and examples.
- [Vite Setup](introduction/vite.md): Reference and examples.
- [Next.js Setup](introduction/next.md): Next.js configuration and consumer setup.
- [CLI Setup](introduction/cli.md): Reference and examples.
- [Why Zyzz](introduction/why-zyzz.md): Reference and examples.
- [Thinking in Zyzz](introduction/thinking-in-zyzz.md): Co-location, composition, authoring feedback, and styling conventions.
- [Editor and Agents](introduction/editor-agents.md): Reference and examples.
- [Compatibility](introduction/compatibility.md): Reference and examples.
- [FAQ](introduction/faq.md): Reference and examples.

## Concepts & Principles

- [Concepts & Principles](concepts.md): Reference and examples.

## Guides

- [Guides](guides/README.md): Topic index.
- [Styling](guides/styling.md): Define, reuse, compose, and bind component styles.
- [Conditions](guides/conditions.md): Respond to viewport size, browser state, and related elements.
- [Themes & Tokens](guides/themes.md): Define token contracts, choose theme scopes, and select color schemes.
- [Variants](guides/variants.md): Define finite choices, defaults, and compound matches for one element.
- [Stylesheets](guides/stylesheets.md): Declare global rules, cascade order, fonts, and animations.
- [CSS Output](guides/css-output.md): Atomic and grouped CSS, composition, and delivery.
- [Build & Delivery](guides/compilation.md): Compile and publish matching artifacts, then deliver styles during server rendering.
- [Testing & Migration](guides/testing.md): Verify rendered behavior, diagnose failures, and migrate existing components.
- [Migrating from StyleX](guides/stylex.md): Translate StyleX definitions, composition, variables, themes, and CSS delivery.
- [React Native](guides/native.md): Compile shared definitions and select native theme tables.
